picks.title: Apertus – Open Foundation Model for Sovereign AI
picks.why_it_matters: Open-source foundation models with a sovereign AI angle could reshape competitive dynamics for AI startups, creating new infrastructure plays and reducing dependency on closed API providers.

picks.title: Deno Desktop

picks.title: Data centers become the face of AI backlash
